title: Clearion
description: This mod will help you to improve your gameplay vision drastically!
body:
#  Clearion

**Clearion** is a fully client side utility mod designed to drastically improve gameplay visibility, clean up visual clutter, and enhance competitive performance in Minecraft. Whether you are climbing the ranks in PvP or exploring deep caverns, Clearion clears the noise so you can focus on the game.

---

## ✨ Features

### ⚔️ Combat Visibility
Take back your screen real estate during combat with customizable first-person rendering settings:
* **Lowered Shields:** Adjust first-person shield height (from default to fully lowered) so it doesn't block your field of view when guarding.
* **Compact Totems:** Scale down the Totem of Undying in your hand to keep it compact and out of the way.
* **Sword Tuning:** Customize both the scale and XYZ translation offsets of swords in your hand.
* **Low Fire:** Minimize the fire screen overlay height when burning so you can see where you are running and who you are fighting.

### 🍃 Clutter-Free Environment & Atmosphere
Disable obstructive screen overlays and particles that hinder your vision:
* **Fog Controls:** Toggle fog on/off individually for the Overworld, Nether, and End. Includes a **Fog Multiplier** slider to push fog further back.
* **Overlay Toggles:** Turn off visual distractions like:
  * Nausea screen-wobble effect.
  * Spyglass vignette/borders.
  * Pumpkin head helmet overlay.
  * Powder snow freezing frost effect.
* **Crystal Clear Water:** Increases underwater clarity so you can navigate oceans and rivers effortlessly.
* **Particle Taming:** Disable invisible entity particles and active potion swirl effects swirling around your head.

### ⚡ Performance & Particle Culling
Optimize your frames and visual clarity during chaotic situations:
* **Cull Explosion Flashes:** Disable the blinding white flash screen overlay when TNT or crystals detonate.
* **Cull Rain Ripples:** Disable rain ripples on block surfaces for improved performance during downpours.
* **Smart Performance:** Toggle block-breaking particles, smoke culling, and force **Fast Leaves** rendering.

---

## ⚙️ Customization (Mod Menu & YACL)

Clearion offers a clean, user-friendly in-game configuration screen using **Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)**. 
* To access the settings, install **Mod Menu**, press `ESC` in-game, navigate to the mods list, and select **Clearion**.
* Configurations are automatically saved to `config/clearion.json`.

---

## 📥 Dependencies

To use Clearion, ensure you have the following installed:

1. **[Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)**
2. **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**
3. **[Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)** (Required for config GUI)
4. **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** (Required to open config screen in-game)
